name: PT Multitrend Indo Tbk
summary: PT Multitrend Indo Tbk engages in the retail trade of children's clothes and toys in Indonesia. The company is also involved in the retail trading of sports, kids, and lifestyle products; and baby clothing and equipment, sportswear, footwear, and accessories. It sells its products through various brand websites, marketplace stores, a network of retail outlets, and a third-party distribution network. The company offers its products under the Mothercare, Early Learning Centre (ELC), Gingersnaps, The Children's Place, The Entertainer, Wilio, Banz, HEAD, Jazwarez, J&J, MICRO, NUBY, Playgro, TY Brand, YAMATOYA, ZOGGS, PT Actavis Indonesia, Babies & Everything, Beaba, Biolane, Clevamama, Momami, P…
